bias_targets.methodology: Prompting vision-language models to name colors across 10 different languages (English, Chinese, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, and Spanish) and comparing the size and consistency of their shared color vocabularies to identify training data disparities.

Presenting models with 3D rendered objects (e.g., cups, sofas, geometric shapes) systematically rendered in 957 distinct colors to measure how object identity biases color naming decisions and modifier usage compared to baseline uniform color chips.
